parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two switch buttons on the wall switch, made of ABS plastic with a smooth surface for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator to open or close an electrical circuit, controlling the connected device or light.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or pressing inward and outward to toggle between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second switch button on the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic, identical in shape and function to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of another device or light source.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing or toggling inward and outward, similar to the first switch.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic that holds the switches in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the electrical components, ensuring insulation and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, providing a stable mounting surface for the switches.
